svg.font-family: Segoe Print, Bradley Hand, Chilanka, Comic Sans MS, cursive
svg.text: LPG-SAM - a 656K adapter steering a frozen 94M model
1. ONE FORWARD PASS - the backbone never moves
4 prior tokens replace the click / box prompt
the adapter begins as an exact identity
z_mod = z at init, so training starts from the
frozen MedSAM baseline and departs only as
far as the loss justifies. No warm-up hacks.
val clDice 0.090 -> 0.831 in 5 epochs -> 0.871 at epoch 26
pixels agree, but vessels must stay connected
0.5 x each - clDice uses 15 soft-erosion iterations
fewer broken vessel trees, not just more correct pixels
